summary: Clean on COR. Every libc wrapper in _c.py forwards its arguments to _call_lib_func in the exact C order, and each signatures_c entry matches the real C prototype's argument count, order, and width for all platforms numbox supports. The platform-variable-type trap (long/time_t) is correctly avoided: none of the affected functions (fseek/ftell/fsetpos/fgetpos/time/clock/strtol/strtoul) are exposed here. size_t and pointer parameters use intp, which is 64-bit on every supported ABI (win_x64, sysv_x86_64, aapcs64 per abi.py _current_platform, all of which reject non-64-bit hosts), so no truncation occurs.
